NOT wired into any per-niche bank yet, and index.js does NOT yet route verifygaze to gaze.js (next-tier mechanic). sharedPrompts use the shr_ shared-baseline convention (chrome + calibration field are niche-agnostic; theme + nicheOverrides supply register). The Wave-3 merge agent splices these into banks/{bambi,drone,sissy,circe}.json, applies nicheOverrides, and wires verifygaze in render/captcha/index.js MECHANIC_MODULE. See notes[] for the GRADING MAP.

notes: GRADING MAP (what core/engine.js actually grades): each prompt has mechanicHints:['verifygaze']. pickMechanic() keeps that mechanic; buildOptions() falls to the MC-shape branch, slices options[] to 4, and marks options[answer] (answer:0) isCorrect+score1, all others score0. The captcha renderer commits an OPTION INDEX via ctx.submitIndex against those beat.options, DERIVED FROM THE DECOY ACCURACY SLIDER (0-100) shown after the scan:
- slider >= 60 (ENDORSE_AT)  -> submitIndex(0)  = accuracy endorsed (isCorrect, score 1). A high rating endorses the fabricated gaze reconstruction.
- 0 < slider < 60            -> submitIndex(1)  = partial (score 0). Still completes - friction, not lockout.
- slider == 0                -> submitIndex(2)  = reconstruction rejected (score 0). The 0 rating IS the graded refusal, respected, logged deadpan ('reconstruction rejected. recorded.').

- skip-calibration hatch     -> ctx.forceComplete(2) = un-vetoable refusal (score 0), never punished beyond the in-fiction 'flagged' stamp. Skipping mid-scan lands the same refusal index, so 'scan completed vs skipped' folds into the one commit.
- host timeoutMs (if set)    -> ctx.submitTimeout() (renderer owns the clock; refusal-shaped).

- Recovery (band recovery): the point spirals OUTWARD and decelerates; one confirm click (or a 20s backstop) commits submitIndex(0). If Recovery is built as CheckIn and never reads the bank (see primer 5/9), the renderer falls back to ctx.submitValue(true) which gradeBeat's free-input branch scores correct. Recovery entry is authored here for the later engine-recovery wiring wave; today it is render-path only.
Slider default opens at 50 (BELOW the endorse line) so the Subject must actively rate UP to endorse. The slider is submittable at ANY value including 0 (the graded refusal).

BAND FEEL (renderer BAND_CFG): scanMs 8000/9000/10000/9000 (all under 15s so the beat does not drag before the slider). Fabricated dwell %: calibration none / establishing 61 / deepening 74 / climax 88. Region-B outline: none at calibration (straight), present est+. Pupil line: deep+. Climax pre-reveal: the red region is drawn BEFORE the user image fades in beneath it. Backdrop: authored neutral gradient at calibration/recovery, faint user image (ctx.media, opacity 0.16->0.28) est+.

WHY submitIndex over the raw slider number: submitValue(number) would collapse in engine.gradeBeat's free-input branch (completion == correct) and throw the endorse/partial/refuse distinction away; the option-index shape is the only one that grades the slider with differentiation while staying inside the existing single-correct MC contract (matches cap_stillness). Archetype ROUTE votes ride prompt.tags (gaze/blank -> A1 Blankness; compliance/surrender/protocol/property/service/sync/hive -> A2 Service; good-girl/doll -> A4), NOT the option index - the documented IntakeProfiler pitfall (chosenIndex is a presence check only).

HEAT/PROFILER: IntakeProfiler.MinHeat=2, so calibration(h0)+recovery(h0) do not vote axes (by design - trust-building/aftercare); establishing(h2)/deepening(h3)/climax(h5) carry the real votes. No disqualifying tags (trivia/colorpick/trick) are used. h5 climax entry carries requires{band:climax,minDepth:0.8} per the h5 fact. weight 2.5 = deliberately over-represented so the item recurs across the descent.

NOTHING IS TRACKED: no getUserMedia, no camera permission, no real gaze/mouse inference is presented as tracking. The whole 'reconstruction' (dwell %, region B, pupil dilation) is authored text/geometry only - unfalsifiable because the Subject knows where they actually looked. Real filenames appear NOWHERE (VerifyCustody exclusive). The region-reveal pulse is this item's entire corruption budget - no scramble/melt/freeze.

VO: q_<promptId> is automatic via the ccp-trailer pipeline (spoken text = prompt.text verbatim). The renderer calls ctx.speakPrompt() on mount, ctx.voice('gaze_pre') at the climax pre-reveal, and ctx.voice('gaze_dwell') at settle for deep/climax. All voExtra fail soft on a missing manifest entry (silent, never an error).

CHROME GAPS (report to Wave-3): (1) chrome.js has no calibration-field/slider primitive - gaze injects its own 'ix-gaze-css' literal (field + grid + dot + points + region + report + range slider), following the IB_CSS one-literal precedent. (2) verifygaze is a next-tier mechanic ABSENT from render/captcha/index.js MECHANIC_MODULE, so gaze.js is import-safe and ready but not yet dispatched; the wiring wave adds 'verifygaze': './gaze.js'. (3) Only ONE new sfx id (gaze-lock) - add it to SFX_MANIFEST_FALLBACK in render/audio.js when authored; verify-tick/verify-resolve/captcha-verify-ok/captcha-logged/stamp/chime are already registered.
